title: Sinnoh jogável — piloto Twinleaf a Sandgem
phase_count_policy: J01-J08 represent solely executable tooling and offline CI (not released or playable regions). J08 offers SHA-verified local-only Android JoiPlay delta ZIP candidate built from an authorized 9-map QA stage, J06 rights/R07, J07 human-reviewed 43 Windows cases, separate Android save profile and file-by-file rights; no deletions, backups, user saves, or live installation. CI uses synthetic fixtures, never proves Game.exe/JoiPlay, sources or rights. A complete engineering bar does NOT change 0/8 native QA.

stages.completion_requires: J05 code: five existing BlueSinnohPilot handlers exercised, physical starter calls corrected, single starter save flag/party compensation, all three Barry trainer versions verified, false/nil battle and dex setter failure fail-closed, isolation and save/reload Ruby fixtures. Native 9 maps+sprites/PBS compilation & physical QA pending; no installed/save migrated.

stages.completion_requires: J06 guarded Windows-only install/launcher and pristine rollback implemented with isolated synthetic CI on Windows/Linux; real private 9-map input, per-file rights proof, MapID review and native engine/PBS still absent, so no QA copy/game launch on real content.

stages.title: Validar Windows, saves e regressões multirregionais
stages.completion_requires: J07 executable QA session harness, J06 SHA/right/MapID/isolated-save binding, native-engine probe gating, 43 exact Windows test cases with optional evidence SHA/validator, 1 Android held for J08, four-region regression requirements. 50 synthetic negative/positive CI cases; NO real 9-map build, human approval, game battle or save/reload performed; J07 native remains pending.

stages.title: Preparar, testar e distribuir piloto Android/JoiPlay
stages.completion_requires: J08 private incremental Android QA-only delta ZIP builder, hash-bound to J06 maps/PBS/owned sprites and J07 43 independently human-reviewed Windows case records; source+Android profile+rights gates, no backup/no deletion/no save migration, offline synthetic CI. No real 9-map package produced, no JoiPlay, no Android QA native evidence: planned/not playable.

blockers: J08 implementa somente gerador e verificador privado de delta Android em código: 8/8 ferramentas prontas não significa jogabilidade instalada. Nenhum ZIP Android real foi gerado ou publicado.
Cinco mapas físicos do piloto ainda ausentes; R07 MapIDs e R08 direitos dos mapas, tilesets, sprites e PBS não certificados em fonte privada real.
J06/J07 exigem Game.exe real em cópia QA isolada e revisão humana independente de 43 casos Windows. Até agora 0/43 Windows e 0/1 Android verificações reais G12.
J08 recusa pacote sem snapshots de Android autorizados, compilações e 43 registros Windows revisados; usa somente ZIP delta, sem deletar arquivos, backups totais ou tocar saves.
Sinnoh permanece planned/não jogável e as demais regiões Decades/Kanto/Johto/Hoenn não são alteradas. Próximo gate físico J09 #236.
